preconditions.description: The number of clues is between 1 and 105, inclusive.
The number of direct clue links that Holmes has already found is between 0 and 105, inclusive.
The divisor for the modulo operation is between 1 and 109, inclusive.
Each direct link is between two distinct clues, each between 1 and n, inclusive.
No direct link is between a clue and itself.

postconditions.expression: output == (number of ways to find exactly T direct links between the clues) % k
postconditions.description: The output is the number of different ways to find exactly T direct links between the clues modulo k.
